sloka: तपोवनं वा दुर्गं वा नदीमम्भोनिधिं तथा ।वयं ते यदि न त्याज्याः सर्वान्नो नय ईश्वर ।। ७.१०७.१४ ॥
transliteration: tapovanaṁ vā durgaṁ vā nadīmambhonidhiṁ tathā ।vayaṁ te yadi na tyājyāḥ sarvānno naya īśvara ।। 7.107.14 ॥

translations.english: O Lord, if we are not to be abandoned by you, then lead all of us, whether to a hermitage, a fortress, a river, or the ocean.
